note: The variable names variant w; the register declares only v. The windows overlap, so only the undeclared reference can refuse.
fails_if: `_compile_thin_register` stops refusing a variable whose `variants` names a key with no [[register.variant]], or refuses it with a plain ValueError instead of the located `thin_declaration_invalid`

sources.description: Authored FK register r (2000-2020) with variant v (2000-2020) and variable COL (2005-2019) that names variants v and w. Plus the SCB sample.

files.Forsakringskassan/fk.toml:
[[register]]
key = "r"
name = "R"
valid_from = "2000-01-01"
valid_to = "2020-12-31"
[[register.variant]]
key = "v"
name = "V"
valid_from = "2000-01-01"
[[register.variable]]
name = "Col"
column = "COL"
data_type = "int"
variants = ["v", "w"]
valid_from = "2005-01-01"
valid_to = "2019-12-31"
